RG-1..15 pass on head because no fixture anchor lies within lines 0-5 of the last cited file.
finding: Phantom citations from trailer JSON and markdown tokens inflate recall (and FP counts without a trailer) in the grader that decided the Task 4.8 replay A/B revert.
critique: The regression tests never place the mandated trailer after a citation with an early anchor.
remediation: Strip the `<!-- LOA-VERDICT ... -->` comment from `text` before `CITE.finditer`, or extend the lookbehind to `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"'*){,\]])`; add RG test: `a.sh:400` + trailer must yield citations == 1 and must not detect an anchor at line <= 5; re-run the replay A/B.
